summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan and source-code audit for Prompt 5:
- Administrator accounts & RBAC (adminp as presidential, admino as officer with secure PBKDF2 hashing, forced initial password change, rate limiting, and permission boundaries).
- Rectangular 4:3 team image frames replacing circular crops across all tiers.
- Complete responsive mobile design across all pages, forms, tables, and dashboards (320px-430px+).
- Button accessibility and functionality audit ensuring >=44x44px touch targets, verified handlers, and active feedback states.
